g1_g2_partition.statement: G1 had 30 strict passes, zero runner timeouts and two other failures; G2 had 30 strict passes, two runner timeouts and zero other failures. Both used the same fixed 56 denominator in separate single runs.

g2_fixed_outcomes.statement: G2 ended the frozen no-hint 56: 54 completed, two 1200-second runner timeouts, zero other failures, and 30 strict passes over all 56. Three completed strict verdicts are unknown.

g2_reserve_reach.statement: All 54 normally completed G2 tasks have reserve records, each unbound. The two timeout tasks lack reserve records; no reserve trigger is proven for them.

g2_stage_coverage.statement: All 56 G2 tasks have answer-blind lifecycle records: all reached the first LLM-call enter and return markers; 54 reached normalization and two received a wall-timeout marker.

g2_timeout_position.statement: The two G2 timeout records have first_llm_call_returned as their last recorded progress stage. The stage recorder does not mark every later model or tool call, so this is not a location for their final in-flight work.

hypothesis_unexercised.statement: The G1 pre-event abort did not recur in G2, so the lifecycle-localization hypothesis remains untested rather than confirmed or refuted.

no_pre_event_abort.statement: G2 had no pre-event terminal failure: every task reached the first LLM-call return marker. Thus the G2 hypothesis about localizing a recurrence of G1's zero-event aborts was not exercised, despite complete instrumentation coverage.

reserve_missing_timeout.statement: The absent reserve records on the two timeout tasks do not establish whether their 120-second reserve was unreachable, not reached at a turn boundary, or simply not persisted before termination.

stage_not_inertness.statement: Complete stage-record coverage and unchanged strict-pass totals do not demonstrate that instrumentation was behaviorally inert; the G1 and G2 runs are separate and stochastic.

strict_not_timeout_proxy.statement: The change from zero to two timeouts across G1 and G2 did not change the count of strict passes, so timeout totals alone cannot stand in for strict task success.

timeout_trace_gap.statement: Only 54 G2 full traces exist. The two timeout tasks have lifecycle markers but their later within-task behavior and in-flight final call are not established by those markers.

unknown_verdicts.statement: Three normally completed G2 tasks have no strict verdict; they remain unknown within the fixed denominator, without inspecting validators or answers.

unpaired_runs.statement: One unpaired run per generation cannot establish that G2 instrumentation caused the changed timeout and other-failure partition, or that the unchanged strict total reflects a null effect.
